steps.sub: counts check-ins or app activity in the last 30 days

steps.label: Product
steps.sub: counts active studio-location rows -- doubles multi-location members

code:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
FROM dbo.memberships
WHERE subscription_status <> 'canceled';

-- "If they haven't canceled, they're active.
--  Paused is not canceled." -- Marcus Yi, Finance
caption: Internally reasonable -- and the reason Finance's number runs highest.

code:
-- Marketing: engagement, not billing status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
FROM dbo.checkins
WHERE checkin_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, GETDATE());

-- Product: active location rows -- not deduplicated
SELECT COUNT(member_location_id)
FROM dbo.member_locations
WHERE is_active_flag = 1;
caption: Two more reasonable rules -- and one confirmed double-counting bug.

subtitle: One written rule, specific enough to check by hand.
